mechanism.finding: The dominant KU damage from the op block is EXTRACTION-SIDE: the model re-routes subsequent count/total updates into op:'add' member claims instead of scalar supersessions, so the total freezes at its first value. Apply-time conversion destruction (the c2op verdict's emphasis, and this guard's target) is real but minor (~3 slots) and flipped zero verdicts; blocking conversion preserves bank hygiene but cannot recover updates that never arrived as scalars.
